description: Image Description: A small, fluffy dog with a tricolor coat—primarily white with patches of black and tan—is standing confidently on a green wooden ramp in an indoor arena. The dog appears to be a Pembroke Welsh Corgi, characterized by its short legs, long body, and perked-up ears.
